An '''ancient terentatek''' was imprisoned within [[Vault S-31]] on the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] during the reign of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]]. The [[Terentatek/Legends|terentatek]] would eventually be awakened in the aftermath of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Invasion of Belsavis|attack]] on the planet thousands of years later, and the Imperial officer [[Executor (Sith Empire rank)|Executor]] [[Krannus]] left the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Gantrell]] at the mercy of the beast after the man was no longer useful. The terentatek was [[Death/Legends|killed]], however, when the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]] rescued the doctor.
